name: CoinGecko
author: Jonny Heggheim
description: Cryptocurrency prices from CoinGecko in the Omarchy bar: a live ticker for your favourite coin plus a popup with price, 1h/24h/7d change, market cap and rank for every coin you follow.

barWidget.description: Crypto price ticker and market overview from CoinGecko

schema.label: Coins to follow
schema.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum,solana. The first one is shown on the bar. Ids are in the URL of a coin's CoinGecko page.

schema.label: Currency
schema.description: Quote currency code such as USD, EUR, GBP, NOK, JPY or BTC. Case does not matter.

schema.label: What to show on the bar
Order of coins in the popup
schema.description: The bar always shows the first configured coin; this only orders the popup list.

schema.label: Abbreviate large prices on the bar (64.5k instead of 64,543)
Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: CoinGecko's free tier allows roughly 5-15 requests a minute and caches prices for about a minute, so anything under 60 s buys nothing.

schema.label: CoinGecko Demo API key (optional)
schema.description: A free Demo key from coingecko.com/en/developers/dashboard raises the rate limit. Left empty, the public endpoint is used.
